title: EvolveSignal: A Large Language Model Powered Coding Agent for Discovering Traffic Signal Control Strategies

mechanism.domainTask: Fixed-time traffic signal control algorithm discovery in SUMO
mechanism.populationDetail: One Program Database retains multiple candidate programs with MAP-Elites diversity organization; no persistent island partition is reported.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The MAP-Elites program database preserves diverse high-performing candidates, though descriptors and cell admission are not specified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The Program Database functions as both the maintained population and quality-diversity archive; its precise cell update is not exposed.
mechanism.generationDetail: One selected parent can receive localized code modifications or a full rewrite; separate inspiration programs provide context.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Delay and stops are normalized then combined into the scalar optimization score; program metrics are stored and included in later prompts.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Algorithm 1 samples one parent from the Program Database and selects inspirations separately by top-k/diversity; parent-sampling distribution is unspecified.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/EvolveSignal A Large Language Model Powered Coding Agent for Discovering Traffic Signal Control Algorithms.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Exact MAP-Elites cell replacement, parent-sampling rule, and local-edit/full-rewrite selection are unspecified. Manuscript cites only broad rewrite, while Appendix A also permits local edits. Bibliographic title/year differ between PDF and Survey/reference.bib.
